rows.what_the_ink_shows: The displayed Ext^1 formula has an underlined Pic followed by subscript A/k. The upper-right area of Pic is blank: there is no superscript 0. Seen on the full scan and in enlarged contrast crop crops/133_scan042_L847.jpg.
rows.note: Keep the written underlined Pic_{A/k}, which agrees with the original LaTeX. The correction row proposes Pic^0_{A/k} for the mathematical statement and attributes that refinement to Michel Hua’s project; this is an authorial omission/refinement, not a transcription error. This review checked the ink only and did not independently prove the Weil–Barsotti statement.

events.outcome: Direct optical comparison confirms that original LaTeX Pic without a superscript 0 matches the displayed manuscript formula. The proposed 0 is absent from the ink; retain transcription and explain the mathematical refinement in a note.
